notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
Hey folks,
the Funtasia public demo is finally available to everyone!

[previewyoutube=pIzZO61jTJ0;full][/previewyoutube]

You can play 2 different game modes:
[list]
[*] Story, defeat the monsters that filled Funtasia with garbage.
[*] Local Multiplayer, challenge your friends in 3 competitive or cooperative mini-games.
[/list]
The demo will only feature 2 of the 10 kingdoms of Funtasia. 
Online multiplayer game mode will be available in the early access version.

The development of Funtasia is still ongoing, so don’t forget to give us some feedback to improve the game before the release in Early Access.

We hope that you like our demo.
